name: vwap_crossover_flow_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index spends 2.5+ minutes (30+ bars at 5s) consistently below session VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms accumulate a growing execution deficit versus their benchmark — every fill they get is worse than VWAP. A subsequent crossover back above VWAP accompanied by a 3x+ volume surge fingerprints multiple TWAP/VWAP algos crossing their internal trigger simultaneously, shifting from gradual accumulation to active catch-up. The cross bar closing in the top 25% of its range confirms the absorption is clean with no counter-selling, and these algos' residual order queues drive sustained directional momentum for 30-60 seconds. The inverse holds for downward crosses after price has been persistently above VWAP.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP cross after 2.5+ minutes of persistent one-sided positioning, with 3x volume surge and close in top/bottom 25% of bar range
